description: Ding, Yu and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. One turbine provides a year of ten-minute observations and a derived hourly series for time-series analysis. The description explicitly discusses missing data. The hourly representation is derived from the same measurement source and is not a second independent dataset. Coverage is this source-defined turbine series; the turbine site, precise recording dates and full sensor schema remain unspecified in the metadata. The collection supports wind-energy time-series modelling with its aggregation and missingness limits retained. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. The native file inventory establishes deposited data, but values and linked file bodies were not read. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance.
